purpose: Durable repo-level reference for CIRS API orchestration, specialist handoffs, and instruction-sync updates.

whenToUpdate: When durable backend workflow or rollout priorities change.
When specialist output introduces reusable constraints, validation defaults, or handoff notes.
When agent instructions would otherwise need duplicate durable updates across multiple files.
doNotStore: Secrets, tokens, credentials, or personal data.
One-off chat recap without future planning value.

include: handoff notes another agent should inherit

stableFocus: Keep /api/v1 backward-compatible unless a task explicitly authorizes a breaking change.
Stay Tuguegarao-first and fail-closed on privacy, authorization, and public exposure.
Use factory CRUD for standard resources and keep incidents in custom domain logic.
Keep Prisma schema, SQL migrations, auth boundaries, and tests aligned.

currentReference.crossRepoBoundary: Return dashboard or mobile follow-up as coordination notes for xypes-platform-orchestrator instead of implementing cross-repo from the API repo.

coordinationNotes: Backend is the source of truth for contract, roles, privacy boundaries, and rate-limit behavior.
Public and citizen-facing trust endpoints must stay redacted, enumeration-resistant, and least-privilege.

Everything emitted to the mirror repository is production-facing output and must be treated as production: exclude local-only docs, internal setup instructions, secrets, and non-production artifacts, and review mirror-published changes with the same caution as production outputs.
Role or route changes should be checked against docs/dashboard-crud-config.flat.json for drift.

When routes, auth surfaces, or allowedRoles change, regenerate docs/dashboard-crud-config.json and docs/dashboard-crud-config.flat.json from src/docs/dashboardCrudContract.ts; CI can fail on formatting-only drift if generated artifacts were edited by hand or not refreshed.
Treat SYSTEM_ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN as backward-compatibility aliases only; do not reintroduce them as first-class roles in docs, UI, seeds, or contract updates.

For the Tuguegarao-first pilot, NATIONAL_ADMIN should stay disabled in the live roster unless cross-LGU governance is formally approved; do not use it as a stand-in for city operations or generic platform-owner access.
Direct in-repo HTTP test proof now exists for the geography CRUD route surface, privacy-incident admin endpoints, public case lookup privacy behavior, and rate-limit threshold behavior.

Remaining readiness blockers are now mostly live-environment proof, deploy-facing smoke depth, rollback and restore evidence, and external governance approvals rather than missing core backend features.

Geography remains contract-backed and seeded from the API perspective, while the dashboard intentionally keeps geography out of primary Tuguegarao-first pilot navigation until that pilot-visible workflow is explicitly widened.
validationDefaults: Prefer targeted Jest and Supertest coverage for touched endpoints and denial paths.
Run narrow type/build validation after non-trivial backend changes.
Use git diff --check when customization changes have no narrower executable validation.

workingState.activeArea: Shared agent-context adoption for orchestrators and specialists.
notes: Treat this file as the canonical durable reference instead of duplicating updateable state across multiple agent files.
